subject: SOC2 evidence: auth sampling, MFA rotation logs, and bridge-letter options
messages:
From: Oliver Hayes <security@bluecovehealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@bluecovehealth.com
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 Type II + additional auth evidence request

Hi Diego,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. As part of BlueCove Health's vendor security review ahead of a pilot, our security team needs the latest SOC 2 Type II report and a small set of supporting control evidence related to authentication and privileged access. Specifically we need: 

- SOC 2 Type II report for the most recent audited period (please attach)
- A bridge letter if the report does not cover our requested audit window (see below)
- MFA configuration/rotation evidence for admin/privileged accounts (we usually ask for rotation matrix + timestamps)
- Authentication log slices for a representative sample of services (we typically request 2-4 apps and 30–90 days per app)
- Privileged access review artifacts (e.g., review spreadsheet or sign-off document)

Our desired audit window for operational evidence is 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31. If your SOC 2 report only covers 2024, we will need a bridge letter that explains the controls in place during the 2025 window and any compensating controls.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the report and the slices above, and let us know delivery options (secure link, SFTP, or encrypted email)? Also please advise on expected turnaround if we ask for minimal redaction.

Appreciate it — we’re trying to finish the security sign-off by the end of May.

Best,
Oliver Hayes
Security Program Manager
BlueCove Health

Attachment: requirements_checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Hayes <security@bluecovehealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 12:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 Type II + additional auth evidence request

Hi Oliver — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the SOC 2 Type II report (most recent fiscal year) and a set of sampled control artifacts. A few clarifying items so we scope exactly what you need: 

1) Audit window: you asked for 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31. Our latest SOC 2 covers 2024 and the next Type II period closed 2024-12-31. We can draft a bridge letter to explain continuity and any changes since the report; Evelyn is on-copy to draft that.

2) Sample sizes: for logs we typically provide a 30–90 day slice per service. For MFA rotation we can produce a rotation matrix and timestamps for the last rotation events for the 6 most-privileged accounts if that meets your needs. If you require more users, let us know (we usually do 5–10 admin accounts).

3) Redaction & delivery: we will redact PII and IP addresses on request. Preferred delivery is a time-limited secure Box link with password; SFTP is possible but slower. We will provide a manifest describing redaction and the data fields removed.

4) Format: CSV for log slices, PDF for bridge letter and privileged access review artifacts, and CSV/Excel for rotation matrices.

Timeline: If you confirm the sample sizes and acceptance of a Box link, we can prepare the evidence bundle within 3 business days.

Next steps: please confirm (a) acceptance of the proposed sample sizes (30–60 days per app, 6 admin accounts for MFA rotation) and (b) whether you need the bridge letter to cover the full 2025 year or only the first half. Once confirmed, Mina will pull the slices and Evelyn will draft the bridge letter.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales — Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_soc2_type2_2024.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Oliver Hayes <security@bluecovehealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@bluecovehealth.com
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 Type II + additional auth evidence request

Diego — thanks for the fast reply and for attaching the SOC 2 report. Quick clarifications: 

- We do need the bridge letter to cover the entire 2025 calendar year. That helps our risk committee.
- For log slices, please provide 60 days per representative service. The three services we are most interested in are: auth-service (token issuance), web-frontend (user sessions), and admin-console (privileged actions).
- For MFA rotation, we require timestamps showing rotation events for the last 6 privileged accounts plus evidence that rotation policy enforces rotation every 180 days (or the closest policy you maintain).
- Privileged access review: a signed review or spreadsheet showing reviewer, date, and actions taken is sufficient.

Delivery: Box link with password works. Minimal redaction is fine — please scrub obvious PII and provide a manifest.

HubSpot ticket with our procurement details is here: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/ticket/BC-98234

If you can confirm timeline and deliverables we’ll mark the security review as in-progress.

Cheers,
Oliver

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Oliver Hayes <security@bluecovehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 7 May 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Evidence pull request for BlueCove (action items)

Mina / Evelyn — looping you in per Oliver's confirmation. Request from BlueCove: 60-day log slices for three services (auth-service, web-frontend, admin-console) covering a 2025 sample window they specified; MFA rotation timestamps for the last rotation events for 6 privileged accounts; privileged access review artifact (signed spreadsheet or PDF). They want a bridge letter covering calendar year 2025.

Action items: 
- Mina: please extract the log slices for the three services and apply standard PII redaction. Use the sample window of 2025-05-15 to 2025-07-13 for the primary slice (we'll include manifest describing slice offsets). Produce CSVs and include header mapping. Also pull rotation event metadata for the six admin accounts and export as a CSV (mfa_rotation_matrix.csv). Attach a short README that explains the fields removed. Target: 2 business days.

- Evelyn: please draft a bridge letter that: (a) states our latest SOC 2 period, (b) explains control continuity through calendar year 2025, (c) notes any material changes (none expected), and (d) states the scope of the provided artifacts. We will send the draft to BlueCove for acknowledgement before finalizing. Target: EOW.

- Diego: I will assemble the bundle and create a Box link set to expire in 7 days with password protection. Include the manifest and list of attachments in the top-level README.

Let me know if you need legal to review the bridge language — unlikely for a standard service continuity letter but available if needed.

Thanks — Diego

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Hayes <security@bluecovehealth.com>, procurement@bluecovehealth.com
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 Type II + additional auth evidence request — delivery plan

Oliver — following up with the proposed delivery. We have assembled a minimal evidence bundle and a draft bridge letter. Contents of the bundle (attached to the Box link below):

- redwood_soc2_type2_2024.pdf (SOC 2 Type II report)
- redwood_bridge_letter_2025-draft.pdf (draft bridge letter covering calendar year 2025)
- mfa_rotation_matrix.csv (rotation timestamps for 6 privileged accounts; policy reference included)
- auth_log_slice_app1_20250515-20250713.csv (auth-service sample)
- auth_log_slice_app2_20250515-20250713.csv (web-frontend sample)
- auth_log_slice_app3_20250515-20250713.csv (admin-console sample, PII redacted)
- privileged_access_review_2025-Q1.pdf (signed review artifact)
- README_evidence_manifest.txt (redaction notes, field mapping, and sample selection rationale)

Delivery link (expires 2026-05-16): https://box.redwood.example.com/s/secure-evidence-bundle-expiring-2026-05-16
Password: (sent to you via separate secure channel)

Timeline: We prepared the primary bundle per your requested sample sizes. If you require additional users, longer slices, or raw log exports unredacted we will need to open a formal data request (PO or DPA addendum) and extend the timeline.

Please review the draft bridge letter and artifacts and let us know if you want any edits. Once you acknowledge we will finalize the bridge letter and print-sign the PDF.

Next step: acknowledge receipt and indicate whether the provided bundle meets your requirements or if you need any follow-ups.

Regards,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales — Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: redwood_soc2_type2_2024.pdf, redwood_bridge_letter_2025-draft.pdf, mfa_rotation_matrix.csv, auth_log_slice_app1_20250515-20250713.csv, auth_log_slice_app2_20250515-20250713.csv, auth_log_slice_app3_20250515-20250713.csv, privileged_access_review_2025-Q1.pdf
